title: 21. Projects: Real-Time Analytics Platform (capstone design)
summary: Design and build a real-time analytics platform like Google Analytics / Mixpanel.
objectives: Build the Real-Time Analytics Platform (capstone design) projects end to end
Keep a short README with assumptions and tradeoffs

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.body:
Design and build a real-time analytics platform like Google Analytics / Mixpanel.

**You will build:**

1. Event ingestion pipeline (high throughput)
2. Real-time dashboard with aggregations
3. Batch analytics with PySpark
4. Data warehouse schema (Star Schema)
5. Alerting system for anomaly detection
